title: Track switching: within three business days; no fee or frequency limit in the regulation

source.title: Income Tax Regulations (Rules for Approval and Management of Provident Funds) 1964, reg. 33ב(ב) (Wikisource)

switch_business_days.notes: For a kupat gemel lehashkaa the three business days come from the bylaws (Altshuler clauses 20.1 to 20.4); the regulation does not name the product.
